emails.subject: Your updated vessel schedule tool
emails.html:
Hello,

I saw your October post launching the updated vessel schedule tool, with ETAs, cargo cutoffs and alerts when schedules change. With customs, freight and transport desks in Mascot and Chipping Norton, your team prices a wide mix of requests.

We are Tiph, a software company in London, and we built Kazinga for the quoting side of a forwarder's day. It uses AI to read incoming rate requests, then prices them from your own tariffs and margin, and drafts the reply. Your team checks every quote and sends it. Your data is encrypted, and Tiph cannot read it.

We can also set Kazinga up to quote each customer from their own past quotes and orders, as a customisation aimed at raising the value of each account.

Would a 20-minute demo be useful?

Kind regards,
Ratif Ssemujju
Tiph Ltd, 128 City Road, London EC1V 2NX, United Kingdom
